notes.title: Playtest 7th Patch note
notes.notes:
Volume slider reset bug fixed

Boss health bars more visible

Some movement sounds for tower golem and holy knights fixed

Some 3 rune towers firing rate reduced

Slight adjustment of neutral camps in level 2

Healing shrine cost reduction

Pickup ui animation

Adjusted teleport code to avoid glitches.

200k+ enemies slain so far this playtest, keep it up!

notes.title: Playtest 6th Patch note
notes.notes:
Day timer now pauses during the 1st day on a new level until you take action.

New enemy death vfx

HUD enemy spawn icons now have additional + symbols when a mixed spawn is coming

Codex bugs rectified

Wizard's auto projectiles no longer whiff targets

Reduced Holy Knights AOE damage

Reduce Bone Wall's Health.

Pause Icon near day timer shown when game is paused

Hundreds of thousands of enemies have been defeated during this playtest so far. Keep on slayin'!

notes.title: Playtest 5th Patch Note
notes.notes:
Changed volume sliders to logarithmic.

Tier 2 Archers population cost corrected to 4.

Drafting building upgrades with existing buildings will no longer negatively affect population.

Some text fonts enlarged.

Build screens and Upgrade screens can no longer be opened simulataneously.

Fixed some double tap UI issues.  



Thank you for all the feedback helping make the game all it can be!

notes.title: 4th Playtest Patch notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Level 3 collider fix 

Drafting building upgrades no longer cost resources (fixed bug).

[/olist]

notes.title: Playtest 3rd patch notes
notes.notes:
Getting caught on tower upgrade fixed

Fixed volume sliders

Reduced wall health and increased cost

Some text typos fixed.



Many thanks to those who left feedback. Please continue to do so as it helps improve the game!

notes.title: Playtest 2nd Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Lowered star requirements for tutorial

Reduced tower lighting

Fixed chest sound

Fixed Plague Tower missing and rebuild

Ranged enemy units now stop to fire

Thanks again for the play test feedback, please keep it coming and we'll continue to improve the game!

notes.title: 1st Playtest Patch
notes.notes:
Improved unit pathing

Stopped swordsman spawning mid air 

Fixed some nav issues Buffed most spells power 

Reduced some rune drops 

Clarified tutorial resource collection pointer

Volume slider response fix



Keep up the feedback thank you 🙏

notes.title: Highscore system update
notes.notes:
Following ever helpful feedback, we've added a clearer scoring system at the end of a win. There are also some lovely quality of life issues we're tackling such as the building placement controls and the ever expanding waves of enemies tweaking.

Stay tunes for more updates as we continue to develop Castillon!
